claim.claim-text: 1. A filtered tube set (30) for use with a gas delivery device for performing an endoscopic surgical procedure in a surgical cavity (18), comprising:
2. A filtered tube set as recited in Claim 1, wherein a fitting is operatively associated with a distal end of the first lumen (34) for connection with a first valve sealed access port.
3. A filtered tube set as recited in Claim 1, wherein a fitting is operatively associated with a distal end of the second lumen (34) for connection with a second valve sealed access port.
4. A filtered tube set as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one filter element is disposed within the first filtered flow path of the filter cartridge (32).
5. A filtered tube set as recited in Claim 1, wherein at least one filter element is disposed within the second filtered flow path of the filter cartridge (32).

6. A filtered tube set as recited in Claim 1, wherein the first lumen (34) is configured for bi-directional gas flow so as to facilitate stable pressure in the surgical cavity and facilitate smoke evacuation from the surgical cavity.
